_note: Per-league % of scouting-relevant players (>=450 min) with a non-null tm_player_id in gold.agg_scouting_player_season, at the time this baseline was captured. Used by send_daily_summary.py to flag leagues that regress more than 5pp below this baseline (club_name_aliases coverage gap, TM scrape miss, etc.). Re-capture deliberately after any change expected to improve match rate (don't silently ratchet down after a real regression -- only refresh after verifying the new lower rate is not itself a bug).
